title: Effective weir length as a fraction of the peripheral length
readable: weir length = 70/93 = 75% of the peripheral length

symbols.definition: length of masonry bevelled weirs, cm
pitch of the brick pillars, cm

applicability: Effective weir length of the masonry bevelled weirs between brick pillars on the RCC sidewall of the clarifiers at the 23 MLD CMWSSB STP.
notes: Printed inline in running prose, not as a displayed or numbered equation; p356-1 is a service locator.
The printed 75% is a rounded value: 70/93 = 75.27%. No correction made.
The pillar pitch is printed as 14 cm thick brick pillars of 23 cm length interspaced with masonry bevelled weirs of 70 cm length.
